title: Depth Before Breadth: Reverse-to-Forward Curriculum with Advantage Decomposition for LLM Agent
abstract: arXiv:2611.24697v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Reinforcement learning (RL) has become a common approach for training large language model (LLM) agents on long-horizon tasks. However, learning from sparse terminal rewards makes credit assignment and exploration difficult. We approach these challenges through a policy-induced capability region, the set of states from which the current policy can reliably complete a task. Near its boundary, an agent may need only a few actions to reach a more solvable state, even when the goal remains distant. This reduces long-horizon learning to two coupled subproblems of reaching that state and completing the task from there. We address them with paired advantages and a progressive reverse-to-forward curriculum. The advantages provide separate signals for reaching more solvable states and completing the task from them, while the curriculum expands the capability region backward along successful reference trajectories and then into off-reference state

translated_title: 深度先于广度：面向大语言模型智能体的逆向到前向课程学习与优势分解方法
translated_abstract: 强化学习（RL）已成为训练大语言模型（LLM）智能体完成长程任务的常用方法。然而，仅依靠稀疏的终端奖励进行学习使得信用分配和探索变得困难。我们通过策略诱导的能力区域来应对这些挑战——能力区域是指当前策略能够可靠完成任务的states集合。在能力区域的边界附近，即使目标仍然遥远，智能体可能只需少量动作就能到达一个更容易求解的状态。这将长程学习简化为两个耦合的子问题：到达该状态以及从那里完成任务。我们通过配对优势和渐进式的逆向到前向课程来解决这两个问题。优势分解为“到达更容易求解的状态”和“从这些状态完成任务”提供分离的信号，而课程学习则沿成功的参考轨迹逆向扩展能力区域，然后再扩展到参考轨迹之外的状态。
tldr: 该论文提出基于策略诱导能力区域的配对优势分解与渐进式“逆向到前向”课程学习方法，将长程稀疏奖励任务分解为“到达更易求解状态”和“从该状态完成任务”两个耦合子问题，从而改善信用分配与探索效率。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes paired advantage decomposition with a progressive reverse-to-forward curriculum based on a policy-induced capability region, decomposing long-horizon sparse-reward learning into reaching more solvable states and completing tasks from them, thereby improving credit assignment and exploration.
